title: 东北证券 API Key 配置
description:
粘贴前请注意：只填 Key 本体，不要带空格、换行、引号或 Bearer 前缀（服务端会自动补 Bearer）——多一个字符就会连接失败。
凭证只保存在你的本机，不会上传。
连不上时：提示「认证凭证缺失或有误」= 没填或格式不对；提示「签名未找到对应的aksk信息」= Key 无效或已过期，请重新领取。
若显示「连接成功」但提问时报 Unauthorized，说明 Key 未开通该服务权限，请重新领取后重试。
description_en:
Before pasting: enter the key itself only — no spaces, line breaks, quotes, or a Bearer prefix (the Bearer scheme is added automatically). One extra character breaks the connection.
The credential is stored locally on your machine and never uploaded.
If it fails: "Missing or invalid credentials" = empty or malformed; "No aksk found for signature" = invalid or expired key, please request a new one.
If it shows "connected" but queries return Unauthorized, the key lacks permission for that service.
